question: What is web development?
urdu_translation: web development کیا ہے؟
A: The process of repairing computer hardware only / صرف computer hardware repair کرنے کا process
B: The process of creating and maintaining websites and web applications / websites اور web applications create اور maintain کرنے کا process
C: The process of converting analog signals / analog signals convert کرنے کا process
D: The process of assigning IP addresses / IP addresses assign کرنے کا process
correct_answer: B | The process of creating and maintaining websites and web applications / websites اور web applications create اور maintain کرنے کا process

question: Which activity is part of web development?
urdu_translation: کون سی activity web development کا حصہ ہے؟
A: Replacing RAM chips only / صرف RAM chips replace کرنا
B: Routing packets between networks / networks کے درمیان packets route کرنا
C: Creating Boolean truth tables only / صرف Boolean truth tables بنانا
D: Designing, building, and maintaining websites / websites design، build اور maintain کرنا
correct_answer: D | Designing, building, and maintaining websites / websites design، build اور maintain کرنا

question: What does front-end development focus on?
urdu_translation: front-end development کس چیز پر focus کرتی ہے؟
A: What users see and interact with on a website / website پر users جو دیکھتے اور interact کرتے ہیں
B: Only server backups / صرف server backups
C: Only database authentication / صرف database authentication
D: Physical network cabling / physical network cabling
correct_answer: A | What users see and interact with on a website / website پر users جو دیکھتے اور interact کرتے ہیں

question: What does back-end development manage?
urdu_translation: back-end development کیا manage کرتی ہے؟
A: Only headings and paragraph colours / صرف headings اور paragraph colours
B: Only browser tabs / صرف browser tabs
C: Servers, databases, and application logic / servers، databases اور application logic
D: Computer power cables / computer power cables
correct_answer: C | Servers, databases, and application logic / servers، databases اور application logic

question: What does a full-stack developer do?
urdu_translation: full-stack developer کیا کرتا ہے؟
A: Works only on physical hardware / صرف physical hardware پر کام کرتا ہے
B: Works only on network security / صرف network security پر کام کرتا ہے
C: Works on both front-end and back-end development / front-end اور back-end دونوں development پر کام کرتا ہے
D: Creates only printed documents / صرف printed documents بناتا ہے
correct_answer: C | Works on both front-end and back-end development / front-end اور back-end دونوں development پر کام کرتا ہے

question: In a login system, which task belongs mainly to the back end?
urdu_translation: login system میں کون سا task mainly back end سے تعلق رکھتا ہے؟
A: User authentication and database interaction / user authentication اور database interaction
B: Displaying the login button colour / login button کا colour display کرنا
C: Choosing heading size / heading size choose کرنا
D: Drawing a page logo only / صرف page logo draw کرنا
correct_answer: A | User authentication and database interaction / user authentication اور database interaction

question: What is HTML mainly used for?
urdu_translation: HTML mainly کس لیے استعمال ہوتی ہے؟

B: Creating the structure and content of web pages / web pages کی structure اور content create کرنے کے لیے

urdu_translation: <!DOCTYPE html> کا purpose کیا ہے؟
